fields.description:
Spun from 73d8 (brainy-convulsant-unicorn) and 551b (sanidine-cilium-eland) during the 2026-08-30 error-code decision pass.

## Problem
`error_code_for` (`src/rebar/_errors.py`) branch 6 maps ANY `LLMError` to `llm_unavailable`. That over-claims an AI-provider outage for many faults that are not outages: the bare `LLMError` base and non-availability subclasses under `LLMError`/`WorkflowError` (editor missing-bundle, workflow parse/wiring, etc.). This is the residual of origin 8a31's blanket mapping and the systematic completion of epic 3405's descriptiveness intent.

## Operator decision
Latest DECISION NEEDED comment approves narrowing `llm_unavailable` to true outages only: `LLMUnavailableError` maps to `llm_unavailable`; every other `LLMError` subclass maps through its explicit `error_code` attribute when present, otherwise `command_failed`. Fold 73d8's `ExpressionError -> invalid_input` into the same sweep. Preserve dbca AC3: a genuine LLM outage inside an execute step, surfaced through the bare `WorkflowError` wrapper path, still reads as `llm_unavailable`. Deliver 551b's ruled case in this path: editor missing-bundle (`editor.py:475`) maps to `command_failed`. Do not add `environment_unready`.

## Implementation scope
Touch `src/rebar/_errors.py` and tests. Enumerate every `LLMError` subclass in the codebase (`src/rebar/llm/errors.py` plus workflow error classes) with Serena hierarchy/reference checks and a grep/string confirmation, then make each mapping intentional.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] In `src/rebar/_errors.py`, `error_code_for` / `_llm_error_code` returns `llm_unavailable` only for `LLMUnavailableError` and for the preserved genuine execute-step outage wrapper path, verified by focused taxonomy tests.
- [ ] Every other `LLMError` subclass maps to its explicit `error_code` when present, otherwise `command_failed`, verified by a parameterized test covering the complete enumerated subclass set.
- [ ] The editor missing-bundle `WorkflowError` case corresponding to `editor.py:475` maps to `command_failed`, not `llm_unavailable`, verified by a focused test.
- [ ] No `environment_unready` code is introduced; `KNOWN_ERROR_CODES` remains consistent with the intentional taxonomy.

## Testing
Run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest -q` on the focused error-taxonomy tests added/updated for this change, plus `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint` and `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck`. Before push, run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" rebar verify-commit-ticket HEAD` after committing.
